observed.method: partial synthetic WAL write then ENOSPC

checks: An exact-path filesystem override wrote a 17-byte WAL prefix, confirmed the resulting file growth, and returned the pinned Unix IO exception with injected ENOSPC.

The explicit COMMIT reported the corresponding transaction error. The prior WAL bytes, format 5/revision 2 metadata, clock, facts and history, and seed receipt were unchanged, and the attempted batch receipt was absent.

Normal-filesystem reopen recovered the same state. The identical mixed put/patch batch committed at position 2 with the same staged receipt, and the exact format 9/revision 3 state and historical cuts survived another reopen and replay.
scope: One fault on the first WAL write of a synthetic batch commit using the custom filesystem on the exact pinned engine. This is filesystem fault injection without filling the host disk.
